newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder February oper revs $214.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder February oper revs $214.3 mln.

text.p: Knight-Ridder Inc said Monday that February operating revenues were $214.3 million, down 2.6 percent from $220 million in February of 1995.
The company said total February newspaper revenue was $188.8 million, compared to $177.5 million.

Total advertising revenue was up 8.7 percent for the month, on a full-run linage increase of 6.4 percent, and retail advertising was up five percent for the month on a full-run linage increase of 2.4 percent, the company said.

Classified was up 10 percent on a full-run linage increase of nine percent. Excluding acquisitions and Knight-Ridder Financial, revenue in the business information services division was down 8.3 percent for the month, the company said.
